verses.he: וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּמָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said:

verses.he: הַלְאֵ֥ל יִסְכָּן־גָּ֑בֶר כִּֽי־יִסְכֹּ֖ן עָלֵ֣ימוֹ מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.en: Can a man be profitable unto God? Or can he that is wise be profitable unto Him?

verses.he: הַחֵ֣פֶץ לְ֭שַׁדַּי כִּ֣י תִצְדָּ֑ק וְאִם־בֶּ֝֗צַע כִּֽי־תַתֵּ֥ם דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Is it any advantage to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? Or is it gain to Him, that thou makest thy ways blameless?

verses.he: הֲֽ֭מִיִּרְאָ֣תְךָ יֹכִיחֶ֑ךָ יָב֥וֹא עִ֝מְּךָ֗ בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.en: Is it for thy fear of Him that He reproveth thee, That He entereth with thee into judgment?

verses.he: הֲלֹ֣א רָעָֽתְךָ֣ רַבָּ֑ה וְאֵֽין־קֵ֝֗ץ לַעֲו‍ֹנֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Is not thy wickedness great? And are not thine iniquities without end?

verses.he: כִּֽי־תַחְבֹּ֣ל אַחֶ֣יךָ חִנָּ֑ם וּבִגְדֵ֖י עֲרוּמִּ֣ים תַּפְשִֽׁיט׃
verses.en: For thou hast taken pledges of thy brother for nought, And stripped the naked of their clothing.

verses.he: לֹא־מַ֭יִם עָיֵ֣ף תַּשְׁקֶ֑ה וּ֝מֵרָעֵ֗ב תִּֽמְנַֽע־לָֽחֶם׃
verses.en: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, And thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

verses.he: וְאִ֣ישׁ זְ֭רוֹעַ ל֣וֹ הָאָ֑רֶץ וּנְשׂ֥וּא פָ֝נִ֗ים יֵ֣שֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃
verses.en: And as a mighty man, who hath the earth, And as a man of rank, who dwelleth in it,

verses.he: אַ֭לְמָנוֹת שִׁלַּ֣חְתָּ רֵיקָ֑ם וּזְרֹע֖וֹת יְתֹמִ֣ים יְדֻכָּֽא׃
verses.en: Thou hast sent widows away empty, And the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

verses.he: עַל־כֵּ֭ן סְבִיבוֹתֶ֣יךָ פַחִ֑ים וִֽ֝יבַהֶלְךָ פַּ֣חַד פִּתְאֹֽם׃
verses.en: Therefore snares are round about thee, And sudden dread affrighted thee,

verses.he: אוֹ־חֹ֥שֶׁךְ לֹֽא־תִרְאֶ֑ה וְֽשִׁפְעַת־מַ֥יִם תְּכַסֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.en: Or darkness, that thou canst not see, And abundance of waters cover thee.

verses.he: הֲ‍ֽלֹא־אֱ֭לוֹהַּ גֹּ֣בַהּ שָׁמָ֑יִם וּרְאֵ֤ה רֹ֖אשׁ כּוֹכָבִ֣ים כִּי־רָֽמּוּ׃
verses.en: Is not God in the height of heaven? And behold the topmost of the stars, how high they are!

verses.he: וְֽ֭אָמַרְתָּ מַה־יָּ֣דַֽע אֵ֑ל הַבְעַ֖ד עֲרָפֶ֣ל יִשְׁפּֽוֹט׃
verses.en: And thou sayest: ‘What doth God know? Can He judge through the dark cloud?

verses.he: עָבִ֣ים סֵֽתֶר־ל֖וֹ וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֶ֑ה וְח֥וּג שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יִתְהַלָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: Thick clouds are a covering to Him, that He seeth not; And He walketh in the circuit of heaven.’

verses.he: הַאֹ֣רַח עוֹלָ֣ם תִּשְׁמֹ֑ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר דָּרְכ֣וּ מְתֵי־אָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: Wilt thou keep the old way Which wicked men have trodden?

verses.he: אֲשֶֽׁר־קֻמְּט֥וּ וְלֹא־עֵ֑ת נָ֝הָ֗ר יוּצַ֥ק יְסוֹדָֽם׃
verses.en: Who were snatched away before their time, Whose foundation was poured out as a stream;

verses.he: הָאֹמְרִ֣ים לָ֭אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וּמַה־יִּפְעַ֖ל שַׁדַּ֣י לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: Who said unto God: ‘Depart from us’; And what could the Almighty do unto them?

verses.he: וְה֤וּא מִלֵּ֣א בָתֵּיהֶ֣ם ט֑וֹב וַעֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽנִּי׃
verses.en: Yet He filled their houses with good things— But the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

verses.he: יִרְא֣וּ צַדִּיקִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְ֝נָקִ֗י יִלְעַג־לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: The righteous saw it, and were glad, And the innocent laugh them to scorn:

verses.he: אִם־לֹ֣א נִכְחַ֣ד קִימָ֑נוּ וְ֝יִתְרָ֗ם אָ֣כְלָה אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.en: ’Surely their substance is cut off, And their abundance the fire hath consumed.’

verses.he: הַסְכֶּן־נָ֣א עִמּ֑וֹ וּשְׁלם בָּ֝הֶ֗ם תְּֽבוֹאַתְךָ֥ טוֹבָֽה׃
verses.en: Acquaint now thyself with Him, and be at peace; Thereby shall thine increase be good.

verses.he: קַח־נָ֣א מִפִּ֣יו תּוֹרָ֑ה וְשִׂ֥ים אֲ֝מָרָ֗יו בִּלְבָבֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Receive, I pray thee, instruction from His mouth, And lay up His words in thy heart.

verses.he: אִם־תָּשׁ֣וּב עַד־שַׁ֭דַּי תִּבָּנֶ֑ה תַּרְחִ֥יק עַ֝וְלָ֗ה מֵאָהֳלֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up— If thou put away unrighteousness far from thy tents,

verses.he: וְשִׁית־עַל־עָפָ֥ר בָּ֑צֶר וּבְצ֖וּר נְחָלִ֣ים אוֹפִֽיר׃
verses.en: And lay thy treasure in the dust, And the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks;

verses.he: וְהָיָ֣ה שַׁדַּ֣י בְּצָרֶ֑יךָ וְכֶ֖סֶף תּוֹעָפ֣וֹת לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: And the Almighty be thy treasure, And precious silver unto thee;

verses.he: כִּי־אָ֭ז עַל־שַׁדַּ֣י תִּתְעַנָּ֑ג וְתִשָּׂ֖א אֶל־אֱל֣וֹהַּ פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Then surely shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, And shalt lift up thy face unto God.

verses.he: תַּעְתִּ֣יר אֵ֭לָיו וְיִשְׁמָעֶ֑ךָּ וּנְדָרֶ֥יךָ תְשַׁלֵּֽם׃
verses.en: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto Him, and He will hear thee, And thou shalt pay thy vows;

verses.he: וְֽתִגְזַר־א֖וֹמֶר וְיָ֣קָם לָ֑ךְ וְעַל־דְּ֝רָכֶ֗יךָ נָ֣גַֽהּ אֽוֹר׃
verses.en: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, And light shall shine upon thy ways.

verses.he: כִּֽי־הִ֭שְׁפִּילוּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר גֵּוָ֑ה וְשַׁ֖ח עֵינַ֣יִם יוֹשִֽׁעַ׃
verses.en: When they cast thee down, thou shalt say: ‘There is lifting up’; For the humble person He saveth.

verses.he: יְֽמַלֵּ֥ט אִֽי־נָקִ֑י וְ֝נִמְלַ֗ט בְּבֹ֣ר כַּפֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.en: He delivereth him that is innocent, Yea, thou shalt be delivered through the cleanness of thy hands.
